Attachment

Source: R/tier1-attachment.R
shad_attachment.Rd

A file/image attachment chip with media, metadata, an upload-lifecycle state, and action buttons. Part of the chat/AI kit – for composers, message threads, and upload lists. Row up with shad_attachment_group().

Usage

shad_attachment(
  title,
  description = NULL,
  media = NULL,
  actions = NULL,
  orientation = c("horizontal", "vertical"),
  size = NULL,
  state = "idle",
  media_variant = NULL,
  href = NULL,
  class = NULL,
  ...
)

shad_attachment_action(icon, aria_label, ...)

shad_attachment_group(..., class = NULL)

Arguments

title

The file name (truncated when long).

description

Optional metadata (type, size, status).

media

Optional shad_icon() name or a tag (icon or image thumb).

actions

Optional action buttons – see shad_attachment_action().

orientation

"horizontal" (default) or "vertical" (media on top).

size

One of NULL (default), "sm", "xs".

state

Upload lifecycle: "idle", "uploading", "processing", "error", "done". The server flips this to animate progress.

media_variant

"icon" (muted tile) or "image" (cover thumb). Defaults to "icon" when media is an icon name.

href

Optional URL; adds a full-card <a> trigger overlay (labelled from title).

class

Extra CSS classes.

...

For shad_attachment_action(), extra attributes on the button.

icon

A shad_icon() name or a tag for the action button.

aria_label

Accessible label (required – the button is icon-only).

Value

An attachment tag.

See also

Other shadshiny chat components: shad_bubble(), shad_marker(), shad_message(), shad_message_spinner()

Examples

shad_attachment("q3-report.pdf", description = "PDF · 2.4 MB",
                media = "file",
                actions = shad_attachment_action("x", "Remove attachment"))
#> <div class="shad-attachment">
#>   <div class="shad-attachment__media shad-attachment__media--icon" aria-hidden="true">
#>     <svg class="shad-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M15 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V7Z"/><path d="M14 2v4a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h4"/></svg>
#>   </div>
#>   <div class="shad-attachment__content">
#>     <div class="shad-attachment__title">q3-report.pdf</div>
#>     <div class="shad-attachment__description">PDF · 2.4 MB</div>
#>   </div>
#>   <div class="shad-attachment__actions">
#>     <button type="button" class="shad-attachment__action" aria-label="Remove attachment">
#>       <svg class="shad-icon shad-icon--sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"/><path d="m6 6 12 12"/></svg>
#>     </button>
#>   </div>
#> </div>
